title: GET /books has no pagination
evidence: BookApi.java:70-80 returns the full collection unconditionally
suggestion: Not required by the spec; add ?limit/?offset only if large collections are expected

title: PUT /books/{id} is full-replace, nulling omitted optional fields
evidence: BookApi.java:94-106 UPDATE sets year/isbn to null when omitted; README.md:29 documents this intentionally
suggestion: Documented behavior; offer PATCH for partial updates if merge semantics are wanted
